about_the_game:
・About "HAKONIWA DEFENSE"

"HAKONIWA DEFENSE" is a tower defense game.

The protagonist, who has lost his memory, cooperates with the girls to defeat the enemy.

When the protagonist wakes up, he finds himself in a dark forest.

What on earth was he doing, and why is he here?

There is no time to worry. A monster and a strange girl appear.

Please watch to see what the fate of the protagonist and the girls will be.

・Features

The game is divided into a story part and a battle part.

In the battle part, you start with the preparation phase (placement phase), where you tell the girls where to wait.

Each girl has her own unique way of fighting. The protagonist cannot fight directly, but he can help bring out the best in each girl by considering their individual personalities.

Once the preparation phase is over, the battle will begin and proceed automatically.
